localFacts.fact: Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg. The TC40 (50 cm folded) fits by length; the RT90C (59 cm) and the Tri-Pier (65 cm) go in checked baggage.

Sternenpark Westhavelland (Brandenburg) has ten official Beobachtungsplätze for amateur astronomers; several have concrete pads or a Plattenweg for telescopes, others are meadows; visitors are asked to stay on the paths. Spikes for meadows, the tripod's own feet on concrete.

In the German Astrotreff forum, owners point to Berlebach wooden tripods (UNI 18) with the PE200 as the stable alternative to the TC40 for an AM5; Berlebach is not on this list because it has no own Amazon listing.

German terms: Stativ, Säulenverlängerung (PE200), Säulenstativ (Tri-Pier), Harmonic-/Strain-Wave-Montierung, Gegengewicht, Einnorden / Polausrichtung, Zuladung / Tragkraft, Ablageplatte / Spreizteller, 3/8-Zoll-Gewinde.

localPainPoints.pain: The TC40 feels too low (80 cm) for comfortable polar alignment.
localPainPoints.fix: Add the 200 mm PE200 (about 1.000 mm) or pick the taller LiteRoc / CPC tripod.

quotes.text: das TC40 direkt von ZWO: wirkt irgendwie sehr niedrig mit nur 80cm, stell ich mir etwas anstrengend beim Polar Alignment vor

localPainPoints.pain: Without a counterweight the centre of gravity sits off-centre, so a small leg circle can tip over.
localPainPoints.fix: Hang weight low under the spreader, keep leg extensions short, or move to steel legs / the Tri-Pier for heavy scopes.

quotes.text: Harmonic Drives ohne Gegengewicht haben ihren Schwerpunkt weit außerhalb der Mitte. Dadurch ist die Gefahr, dass das Ganze umfällt, wesentlich größer.

localPainPoints.pain: A heavy tripod defeats the point of a light mount for flying.
localPainPoints.fix: For flights the TC40 (2,3 kg, 50 cm) fits the Lufthansa cabin size; the heavier tripods are for car or backyard.

quotes.text: Man kauft sich doch die AM5 weil sie leicht und transportabel ist. Aber eine UNI18 im Flugzeug wird schwierig.

localGain.point: Lufthansa cabin size vs folded length: only the TC40 fits.
German owners' worries (80 cm too low, tip-over without counterweight, heavy tripod vs flying) answered with the fixes from the English post.
Dark-sky site surface (concrete pads vs meadow) at Sternenpark Westhavelland.
